zh-CN.name: Taste Skill（DesireCore 维护版）
zh-CN.shortDesc: 基于 v2.5.0 构建网站和落地页，提供组件、样式与手动浏览器检查。需 Node.js 22+ 和 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium，FFmpeg 可选。在线素材、地图与字体走第三方服务，发布时保留素材许可和署名。

en-US.name: Taste Skill (DesireCore fork)
en-US.shortDesc: Build websites and landing pages with the v2.5.0 component kit and manual browser checks. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium; FFmpeg is optional. Online media, maps and fonts use external providers. Keep the relevant asset licenses and credits.
